cards.plan: Hook on the face with the opening zoom. Styled phrase THREE / macronutrients.
Three paper objects in a row (bloom, staircase, compass) with labels Enjoyment, Satisfaction, Meaning. Each arrives on its word.
Full, text-centric: ENJOY / your life. plates (Inter 800 + Playfair italic on sage), paper bloom below, rises on "enjoy". Chapter tag 01 / ENJOYMENT.
Graphic-centric card: Enjoyment ≠ Pleasure. Enjoyment arrives on its word, the ≠ draws, Pleasure on its word.
Half, text-centric: "Pleasure" in Playfair; on "not" a line strikes through a small "happiness" below it.
Punchline on the face. Styled to / REHAB. Music dips.
Full, graphic-centric: paper staircase from Struggle (bottom left) to Accomplishment flag (top right). Chapter tag 02 / SATISFACTION.
Half on ink: chapter tag 03 / MEANING and the paper compass, needle settles on "meaning".
Full on ink, text-centric: "Your why." large Playfair italic.
Close on the face. Styled REALLY, REALLY / actively.
